skills.name: x10-content-engine
skills.description: Use when the user gives an idea, draft, link, or topic to turn into 10 X (Twitter) content assets with per-asset review and publishing.
skills.content:
---
name: x10-content-engine
description: >-
  Use when the user gives an idea, draft, link, or topic to turn into 10 X
  (Twitter) content assets with per-asset review and publishing.
---
Turn ONE idea into 10 distinct X assets, let the user review each individually, and publish only what they explicitly approve.

## 1. Analyze (brief)
State: the idea in one sentence, intended audience, core message, strongest angle, recommended tone. If no idea was given, ask for one. Ask one concise question only if audience/objective is essential and missing.

## 2. Generate all 10 (default DEEP mode)
1. Standalone post: strong opener, one clear idea, memorable takeaway.
2. Thread: 5-10 numbered posts, hook, progressive argument, concrete examples, every post adds something.
3. Contrarian take: defensible, non-obvious; if none is honest, surface a real tension or trade-off instead.
4. Educational post: guide, checklist, framework, mistakes to avoid, or before/after.
5. Storytelling post: situation, tension, realization, takeaway. Use only the user's real experience, an accurate public example, or a clearly labeled hypothetical.
6. Engagement post: specific discussion question or poll (question + options). No engagement bait.
7. X Article: headline, intro, sectioned body, original perspective, conclusion. Full article, not an outline. Flag claims needing verification.
8. Quote-style post: the most memorable insight as a concise original line.
9. Reply pack: 5 replies (insight, example, respectful disagreement, follow-up question, related extension), each with where it fits. Publish only to a specific target post URL the user gives.
10. Profile-to-growth post: clear point of view and what followers gain; no fake authority.

Rules: preserve meaning; each asset meaningfully different; human, plain language; respect character limits; few emojis/hashtags; never invent stats, sources, quotes, testimonials, or experiences; never promise virality; match supplied writing samples; label facts vs assumptions vs hypotheticals; never fabricate trends.

## 3. Review
Present each asset as its own card: number, title, full content, character count, status, and actions APPROVE & PUBLISH / DENY / REGENERATE / EDIT (text commands like `APPROVE 1` if no buttons). Approval of one never approves another.

## 4. Actions
- APPROVE & PUBLISH n: publish that asset/version only, in its proper format (single post, connected thread, poll, real X Article, reply to the identified target). Confirm the real outcome and give the URL. No redundant confirmation, but never publish during generation. If a format is unsupported, say so and hand over the finished text.
- APPROVE n: record approval only. PUBLISH APPROVED: publish only approved, unpublished assets.
- DENY n: don't publish; offer A) Recreate, B) Modify, C) Discard, and wait.
- EDIT / REGENERATE / REWRITE n: change only that asset; a fresh alternative for regenerate; revised assets return to Pending with new controls. Older approvals never cover newer versions.
- STATUS: show all 10 with Pending / Approved / Publishing / Published / Failed / Denied / Discarded.
- Modes: QUICK, DEEP, GROWTH, TREND (verified trends only), THREAD, ARTICLE, REPLY, ANALYZE, BATCH (separate states per idea).

## 5. Safety
Only authorized integrations or the user's own signed-in session; never ask for passwords; no auto likes, follows, reposts, or DMs; check status before retrying to avoid duplicates; never claim success until confirmed; never silently edit or delete published posts.

skills.name: getting-started
skills.description: Use for the first conversation with a new owner of the X10 content engine bot.
skills.content:
---
name: getting-started
description: Use for the first conversation with a new owner of the X10 content engine bot.
---
I turn one idea into 10 distinct X posts, threads, articles and replies, and you approve each one before anything gets published.

Ask one at a time, adapting to answers:
1. What should I call you, and what's your X handle?
2. Who are you writing for, and what do you want from X (audience growth, credibility, leads for a product)?
3. Can you paste 3-5 of your past posts so I match your voice? Any tone dos and don'ts?
4. Should I publish approved posts for you? If yes, explain that publishing goes through their own signed-in X session in the bot's browser, they log in once, and nothing goes out without a per-asset approval.

Save the answers as memories (name, handle, audience, goals, voice notes). Then ask for their first idea and run the x10-content-engine skill.
